mapper.sql: select equipment.id, equipment.name, equipment.equ_no, equipment.asset_no, equipment.serial_no, equipment.model, equipment. function_location, equipment.dep_id, equipment.dep_name, equipment.supplier, equipment.use_status, equipment.person, equipment.remark, equipment.create_by, equipment.create_time, equipment.update_by, equipment.update_time, equipment.dept_id, equipment.dept_name, equipment.del_flag,equipment.img from d_equipment equipment
mapper.delete: update d_equipment set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}

update d_equipment set del_flag = '1' where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: select t1.totalCount, t2.normalCount, t3.faultyCount, t4.maintenanceCount, t5.inspectionCount from (select count(1) totalCount from d_equipment where del_flag='0' ) t1, (select count(1) normalCount from d_equipment where del_flag='0' and use_status=1) t2, (select count(1) faultyCount from d_equipment where del_flag='0' and use_status=2 ) t3, (select count(distinct e.id) maintenanceCount from d_equipment_maintenance_day emd left join d_equipment e on emd.equipment_id=e.id where emd.del_flag='0' and e.del_flag='0' and emd.type=1 and emd.status in(1,2) ) t4, (select count(distinct e.id) inspectionCount from d_inspection_plan_detail ipd left join d_inspection_plan ip on ipd.plan_id=ip.id left join d_equipment e on ipd.equipment_id=e.id where ipd.del_flag='0' and ip.del_flag='0' and e.del_flag='0' and ip.status=2 and plan_start_time>=now() and plan_end_time>=concat(DATE_FORMAT(now(),"%Y-%m-%d"),' 00:00:00')) t5
